description: Bounded source mutations for reachable G-code preheating contracts. Each entry requires an exact single source match and the GCodeProcessorReachable test filter.

mutants.description: Invert the zero-delta guard so a nonzero cooling delta returns without emitting the required cooling command.
Disable usage-block construction while preheating is enabled; reachable preheating output must retain its usage blocks.
Disable the second injection pass; reachable preheating output must retain its second-pass commands.
Disable leading usage-block seeding; the first reachable preheating span must retain its initial block.
Continue parsing after finding a reserved tag; the singular query must preserve the first matching tag.
Invert the heating-only condition so a reachable heating transition enters the wrong injection branch.
Invert the cooling-only condition so a reachable cooling transition enters the wrong injection branch.
Reverse the explicit target-extruder condition so a valid target no longer receives its physical extruder selector.
Disable the skippable-line branch; reachable transition output must retain its M632 and M633 markers.
Change the generated M104 origin marker; the reachable transition contract requires the slicer-generated N0 marker.
